capabilities.title: Domain-Separated HMAC-SHA256 Tenant+Epoch KV Cache Addressing
capabilities.core_thesis: Salt every KV-cache page block key with HMAC-SHA256(tenant_id || epoch_salt, canonical_prefix_chain) and disallow unauthenticated shared-pool fallback so cross-tenant page alignment never collides while identical within-tenant sessions reuse 100% of warm prefix blocks.

capabilities.title: Submodular Entropy Gate with Ephemeral Non-Baseline Predicate Coarsening
capabilities.core_thesis: Enforce a per-turn remaining-entropy envelope that replaces high-entropy raw attributes with zero-knowledge range predicates when cumulative bits approach max_budget_bits, and tag outgoing turn disclosures as non-ratcheting ephemeral proofs.

capabilities.title: Ed25519 Algorithm Pinning and Canonical Ring-Monotonic Capability Binding
capabilities.core_thesis: Pin router verification strictly to Ed25519, enforce canonical regex matching on key_id == ring{Bound_ring}_key with zero path separators, and require claimed_ring == Bound_ring with valid signature.

capabilities.title: Thermal-Time-Constant Priority Shielding with High-SOC Battery Load Shifting
capabilities.core_thesis: Guarantee zero curtailment and active thermal boost to vulnerable or high-decay homes below 20.5C while shifting heat-pump draw onto local batteries and thermal mass in well-insulated high-SOC standard homes.

capabilities.title: Churn-Discounted Quadratic Guild-and-Depth Verified Invocation Weighting
capabilities.core_thesis: Weight each package by verified_calls * guilds^2 * depth^2 discounted logarithmically by churn-per-call ratio, starving synthetic PR-splitters while rewarding deep multi-guild cryptographic and solver primitives.

self_blame_prs.friction_detail: Campaign input_vars listed prefix_token_hashes without specifying canonical delimiter framing across multi-block prefixes.
Initial campaign schema did not distinguish raw attribute disclosure from coarsened zero-knowledge range predicates.
Public sample shard only tested POSIX forward-slash traversal (../) while Windows backslash traversal (\..\\) appeared in held-out evaluation.
Raw telemetry streamed per-second heat-pump kW curves instead of pre-computing thermal decay floor margins for human operators.
Multi-ancestor lineage arrays required explicit conservation rounding rules so royalty splits always sum to 1000 units.
